//: Insolvia's corners — the ONE place they are written down, and the third
brand file beside colors.json and fonts.json.
These are OVERRIDES on @insolvia-ai/tokens, through the same seam the
colours and typefaces use. The package's own theme.ts says why the seam
exists: 'radii and fonts exist because the base theme states no corner and
no display face, on the reasoning that both are brand decisions.'
THIS REVERSES A PREVIOUS DECISION, and that is deliberate rather than an
oversight. The base theme sets every step to 0 and Insolvia used to agree
with it — 'square IS the new design'. Square reads as engineered and
deliberate on a page with strong colour doing the separating. On the warm
neutral palette there is no colour doing that: a card is told apart from
the page by a hairline and a few points of lightness, and at 0 radius those
hairlines read as a wireframe rather than as objects. A small corner is
what turns a bordered rectangle into a card.
SMALL IS THE POINT. 10 on a card and 6 on a control — enough to soften an
edge, not enough to read as a pill or a bubble. Anything larger starts to
look like a consumer app, which is the register this product least wants.
`pill` is absent because it is NOT themeable: the package's leaves that
draw a capsule or a circle (Switch's thumb, Avatar) compute their own
radius, and stating one here would be honoured by nothing.
DO NOT hand-copy these into an app. Every consumer is generated from this
file by `npm run tokens`, and `npm run tokens:check` gates it.
